author: Amaya "May" Rader
text: A delicious spot that's affordable, clean, and kind! I got Pico de Gallo, Chorizo tacos, and horchata that tastes like summer.

author: Defne Aksoy
text: Everything was delicious. Both the steak and pork in the tacos were juicy and very flavorful. Generous portions. The guacamole and tortilla chips were among the best we've ever had. Service was fast and attentive and really enjoyed the music that was playing. Definitely will be back regularly.

author: Praghalathan Kanthakumar
text: Great food and service. Portion sizes were really big. Sauces were good too. Atmosphere is the only thing that lacks, but the tasty food makes up for it.

author: Jameriqua Koen
text: OMG when I tell you, this is the best Mexican food that I have had in a while. If you want that good Mexican food taste I promise you this is the place to go. Family oriented, friendly, and a great atmosphere.

author: Evelyn Hammid
text: The tacos are so good, they're everything you would expect from an authentic street taco! The meat was perfectly seasoned and juicy, and the guacamole was on point. Fair prices and quick service too!

author: Paloma Colunga
text: OBSESSED! Being from California I have missed authentic Mexican cuisine. Everything about the food is absolutely amazing. The restaurant itself is clean, cozy and has its own aesthetic. Highly recommend dropping in for some good tacos or sopes!
